traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.desc: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

traits.name: Giant Ancestry
traits.desc: At level 1, you choose a giant ancestry (subrace).

traits.name: Large Form
traits.desc: Starting at level 5, as a Bonus Action you can become Large for 10 minutes: +5 feet of reach and Advantage on Strength checks. Once per Long Rest.
